text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and previewed reasons","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a central claim and maps out the main points in a logical structure."},{"evidence":"each body paragraph starts with a distinct point","quality":"cohesion","description":"It develops ideas in separate, connected paragraphs that are easier to follow."},{"evidence":"formal transitions like \"Firstly,\" \"In addition,\" \"Lastly\"","quality":"text structure","description":"It uses explicit signposting to guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"\"critical analyzing,\" \"open-mindedly and collaboratively,\" \"de-stress for the sake of their health mentally and physically\"","quality":"idea development","description":"It explains claims with fuller elaboration and more extended support."},{"evidence":"\"For example, a student might be at summer camp...\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"It includes concrete examples that illustrate the argument in a specific way."},{"evidence":"\"teachers are humans too\"","quality":"voice","description":"It sounds more controlled and purposeful, with a clearer authorial presence."},{"evidence":"\"detirriation,\" \"councilors,\" \"life\" instead of \"live\"","quality":"conventions","description":"It has fewer and less disruptive spelling and grammar problems overall, making the writing more readable."}]}
